recipe.visualDefinition: A vibrant, high-energy 1990s-style graphic composition featuring a central airbrushed portrait of a woman with red hair, set against a dynamic yellow and orange sunburst background. The layout uses tilted frames and a mix of bold, arched display type and slanted secondary text to convey movement and summer excitement.
coreVisualRelationships: Central portrait framed by a tilted rectangular border
Radiating sunburst lines originating from the center-right
Bold, arched primary typography overlapping the portrait and background
Secondary list-style text following the diagonal lines of the composition
coreInvariants: Airbrushed painterly texture on the central figure
Strong diagonal orientation for all text elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central female portrait, slightly tilted, occupying the middle 60% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large red arched title text in the lower-right quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the portrait, follow the arch of the red text, then move along the diagonal blue text at the bottom and the list of names in the background rays.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is densely packed with rays, text, and imagery to create a 'busy' high-energy feel.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Yellow and orange sunburst background providing warmth and energy.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep red for the primary title to ensure immediate legibility.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Dark blue for the bottom descriptive text and teal/green for background names.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation across all hues with a bright, high-key value range.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy sans-serif and condensed block fonts
letterConstructionRules: Primary title uses a heavy, slightly irregular sans-serif with an upward arch.
Secondary text uses a condensed, tall sans-serif.
Bottom descriptive text uses a slanted, brush-like italic script.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'A' in the main title has a distinctive low crossbar.
Numerical characters are oversized and bold.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of a heavy, arched block sans-serif with a dynamic, slanted brush script.
graphicDevices: White border around the central portrait

preserve: Arched orientation of the main title
Diagonal slant of the bottom text

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and blocky feel for the main title.
Captures the energetic, handwritten feel of the bottom text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a vibrant yellow and orange sunburst background with rays radiating from the right. In the center, place a tilted rectangular frame containing an airbrushed, painterly portrait of a woman with auburn hair and a white flower in her hair, looking slightly upward. Add a thin white border to the frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, bold red title in an upward arch across the lower middle. Below it, add a large red year number. At the bottom, place two lines of dark blue, slanted brush-style text. Scatter small teal names diagonally along the background rays.

verificationChecks: Is the main title arched upwards?
Is the background a high-energy yellow/orange sunburst?
Is the central portrait airbrushed in style?
Is the bottom text slanted and blue?

mustRedesign: Specific artist names in the background
The exact facial features of the woman
postGenerationChecks: Ensure no text is perfectly horizontal.
Check that the red title is the most prominent element.
Verify the airbrushed texture of the portrait.
Confirm the sunburst rays align with the diagonal text.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a central airbrushed portrait in a tilted frame with a vibrant sunburst background and multi-angled, high-contrast typography to create a 90s-era summer event aesthetic.
